HOW IT WORKS

How it works

Go from one selfie to a clearer salon decision in a few simple moves.

01
Upload your selfie

Use a clear, front-facing JPG, PNG, or WebP photo so your face shape reads cleanly.

02
Choose a direction

Browse curated cuts, bangs, and color ideas that match what you want to try next.

03
Preview your new look

See a photorealistic result in seconds and slide between before and after.

04
Save and bring it along

Keep favorites or show the preview in the chair instead of describing it with your hands.

WHY SEEMYCUT

Built for trying looks before you cut

Straightforward try-on details—what works well, what to expect, and how we treat your photos.

New-user credits

Eligible new users receive 1 credits after their first sign-in to try AI hairstyle previews for free.

Privacy-minded processing

Your photo is used to generate the preview. We design the flow to avoid unnecessary sharing of your selfie.

One photo is enough

No app install required. Upload from the homepage and continue on the try-on page.

Cuts and colors for more faces

Preview short and long styles, bangs, and color ideas across different hair types and lengths.

STORIES

People who tried before they cut

Real scenarios where a preview changed the salon conversation.

“I stopped arguing with my stylist about a little shorter. We opened the preview and agreed on the length in under a minute.”

Mia Ortega

First bob cut, NYC

“Tried three fade ideas on the same selfie before my barber appointment. Walked out with the look I actually meant to ask for.”

James Park

Fade regular

“Balayage looked softer on me than on the inspiration photo. Seeing my face with the color saved me from a too-harsh blonde.”

Elena Rossi

Color appointment prep

“I almost walked into the salon asking for curtain bangs. The preview showed they swallowed my face—we landed on a lighter fringe instead.”

Aisha Rahman

First bangs try

“I'd wanted a shoulder crop for months but kept chickening out. Seeing the short version on my selfie made the cut feel decided, not scary.”

Sophie Chen

Long-to-short switch

“Tried two updos and a soft wave before my sister's wedding. I showed the stylist the one that fit the dress—zero guesswork on the day.”
